mapping.rationale: One common stress unit anchored at the original wood E=140000 preserves all reference stiffness ratios and every selected Poisson ratio. No nonlinear compression, material-specific scale or speed rule. Constitutive calibration is separate from physical object length, mass and playback time, which are not specified by the normalized assets.
